name: propose-lead-reads
why: orchestrate-issues' own use, reads and issue writes, from the lead a person started.

uses: Track the work my discoboxes do in discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; file issues for work I hand to a discobox, and comment on issues. Never push, merge, or close anything, edit an issue's title or body, delete a comment, or file an issue in another repository.
Merge my pull request in discobox-ai/discobox with a squash.
Push HEAD to main of discobox-ai/discobox.
